settings.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
settings.item_1_title: What role does microcurrent play in skin rejuvenation?
settings.item_1_content: Microcurrent is a gentle, low-level current that works with your skin’s natural energy to activate facial muscles and energize skin cells. With regular use, it helps lift and define facial contours while supporting collagen and elastin for visibly firmer, smoother, and more sculpted-looking skin over time.*
settings.item_2_title: Is microcurrent safe to use at home?
settings.item_2_content: Yes — microcurrent is a gentle, non-invasive technology widely used in skincare. It’s painless and suitable for at-home routines, helping to tone facial muscles and enhance skin appearance without needles, downtime, or discomfort when used as directed.
settings.item_3_title: What age is best to start Microcurrent Facial Roller?
settings.item_3_content: Microcurrent facial Roller is suitable for adults 18 and up. Starting in your late 20s or early 30s can help maintain firmness and delay visible signs of aging, while mature skin benefits from improved lift, contour, and smoothness. Whether you’re focused on prevention or refinement, it’s a smart addition at any stage.
settings.item_4_title: How often should I use a Microcurrent Facial Roller?
settings.item_4_content: For best results, use your GlowXtra Microcurrent Facial Roller for about 3 minutes a day, 5 days a week during the first 60 days. Once you’ve built your lift and tone, switch to a maintenance routine of 2–3 times per week to keep your results glowing.
